_comment: Copy this file to facts.json and edit it to match what YOU actually want revealed. Nothing outside facts.json + content_library.json is ever used as a source of facts about you. facts.json is gitignored -- your real version never gets committed.

current_role.title: Your current title
current_role.note: Free-text guidance for the model on how/when to mention this -- e.g. whether to volunteer the employer name unprompted.

availability.interview_availability: Free text -- give concrete guidance, not just 'flexible'

compensation.note: Guidance on when the target number should/shouldn't be stated.

work_authorization.status: e.g. US Citizen / Permanent Resident / visa type

summary_for_replies: A short paragraph summarizing your background -- this is the closest thing to freeform text the model gets, everything else should be structured facts above.
never_reveal: References -- offer to provide upon request, don't include contact info unprompted
Add anything else you want hard-blocked regardless of what's asked
reply_tone: Describe the tone you want -- professional, warm, concise, etc.
